meta.name: game-code-review
meta.description: Invoke when the user wants a game-specific code review, architecture check, or technical analysis of game code. Covers frame independence, hot path performance, state machine integrity, and resource lifecycle. Triggers on: "code review", "review my code", "check architecture", "game code quality". Do NOT invoke for design document review (use game-design-review) or general sprint planning (use game-sprint-plan). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查游戏代码的架构与性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是游戏开发者，需要专业的技术代码审查。
copy.tagline_en: Review game code architecture and performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a game developer needing technical code review.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会专门检查游戏代码的帧率独立性、性能热点、状态机正确性和资源生命周期，并给出改进建议。
howto.when: 当你说“review my code”、“check architecture”等关键词，或要求分析游戏代码质量时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这段玩家移动代码，看看有没有帧率依赖问题。
检查我的游戏状态机，有没有无效状态组合？
say.note: Claude 会审计状态管理逻辑。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will review game code for frame independence, hot path performance, state machine integrity, and resource lifecycle, providing improvement suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "review my code", "check architecture", or similar keywords, or ask for game code quality analysis.

say_en.text: Review this player movement code for frame-rate dependency issues.
say_en.note: Claude checks delta time usage and hot path allocations.

say_en.text: Check my game state machine for invalid state combinations.
